issues.description: The checks an inventory passes before it is merged or ordered from.

h1. Driving Requirements
Each part number's count from an inventory, refusing a part listed twice.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# An inventory listing A-1 and B-7: their counts by part.
# An inventory listing A-1 twice: ValueError naming A-1.

issues.summary: Load an inventory from a CSV file
issues.description:
Read a warehouse export, a CSV file with the columns part and count, into the widgets of an inventory, so an inventory can be built from the export rather than typed in.

A count that is not a whole number should be refused.
Add each part's count across every warehouse's inventory, so the nightly restock run orders from one total.

issues.summary: Refuse a negative count when an inventory is counted by part
issues.description:
ticket-draft: drafted 2026-02-02 by Alice Example · open questions: 0
h1. Context
A warehouse export sometimes carries a negative count after a stock correction, and by_part passes it through, so the restock run under-orders that part. The purchasing team found two such orders in January.
*Touches:* {{src/widgets/inventory.py}}, {{by_part}}
*Used by:* the nightly restock run, {{merge}}

h1. Where it fits
Epic PROJ-10, Inventory checks. Builds on PROJ-31. Wanted before the March restock review.

h1. Driving Requirements
An inventory that holds a negative count is refused when it is counted by part, naming each part whose count is negative.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# An inventory with A-1 at -2 and B-7 at -1: ValueError naming A-1 and B-7, observed by a unit test with a two-row fixture.
# An inventory with a count of zero: counted as zero, not refused.
# An inventory with no negative count: the counts by part, as today.

h1. Not this ticket
* Merging counts across warehouses: PROJ-44
* Correcting the warehouse export itself (candidate)

issues.summary: Refuse an empty part number when an inventory is counted by part
issues.description:
ticket-draft: drafted 2026-02-09 by Bob Example · open questions: 0
h1. Motivation
A warehouse export with a blank part cell yields a widget whose part is the empty string, and by_part counts it as a part of its own, so the order sheet carries a row no supplier can fill.

*Impact:*
* The purchasing team stops sending suppliers rows with no part.

h1. Driving Requirements
An inventory holding a widget with an empty part number is refused when it is counted by part.

h2. Technical Requirements
* The refusal is a ValueError, as by_part's other refusal is (PROJ-31).

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# An inventory with a widget whose part is the empty string: ValueError saying a part number is empty.
# An inventory with no empty part number: the counts by part, as today.

h1. Related Out of Scope Tickets
* [PROJ-44 Merge inventory counts across warehouses|https://jira.example.com/browse/PROJ-44]

h1. The code today
*Touches:* {{src/widgets/inventory.py}}, {{by_part}}
*Used by:* nothing outside this repository
*Missing:*
* No check on the part number
